# Syndrome Reversibility Distance

Purpose: classify information irreversibly lost when a known product of
single-qubit unitaries is followed by the full original stabilizer-syndrome
measurement. Recovery knows U, receives syndrome and remaining quantum state,
and occurs only after that measurement.

Start here:
- README.md: main support criterion, sharp exponent, code-family separation,
  protected-control coexistence, learning route and reproduction command.
- science/README.md: topic-based proof route, complete protected-control catalog,
  finite-certificate scope and links to every authoritative science file.

Readout science:
- science/model.md: conventions, measured channel, branch effects, recovery
  quantifiers, optimal entanglement fidelity and error measures.
- science/support_criterion.md: exact-support equivalence, constructive witness,
  r(S), minimal even logical circuits, parity and ordinary-distance relation.
- science/error_exponent.md: collision-polynomial bound, polar recovery,
  exact even-repetition converse and fixed-code optimized exponent.
- science/code_families.md: five-qubit seed, concatenation, one-physical-CNOT
  code conjugation, preserved parameters and ten-qubit physical witness.
- science/interpretation.md: tensor factors, operation order and physical scope.

Protected-control coexistence, shared with Error-Transparent Locality:
- science/gate_readout_tradeoff.md: minimum general order forces r(S)=d+1;
  stronger readout separation needs more order; ancilla and circuit caveats.
- science/minimum_readout_safe_gates.md: Q_m one-error optimum on all axes.
- science/sparse_protected_gates.md: explicit <=4n one-error construction,
  <=3n+1 existence bound and coefficient-size distinctions.
- science/two_error_gates.md: 25-qubit two-error primal/dual certificate.
- science/growing_two_error_gates.md: all-depth two-error optimum and correlated
  padding; do not confuse it with independent uniform inactive-leaf padding.
- science/sparse_two_error_synthesis.md: positive sparse component certificates,
  exact pairwise coupling and reference compiler, including 125-qubit example.
- science/three_error_gates.md: 25-qubit seven-pattern three-error optimum.
- science/growing_three_error_gates.md: strict truncated-tensor lifting,
  all-depth three-error optimum, coefficient bounds and exact response profiles.
- science/protected_entangling_gates.md: fixed product-code Pauli strings,
  target-coset lower bound, tensor-budget composition and universal control.

Sources and verification:
- references/RELATED_WORK.md: attribution, neighboring models and source limits.
- references/references.bib: bibliographic records and versions.
- verification/README.md: all 12 programs, expected checks and their limits.
- verification/run_all.py: reproduction entrypoint; run it for fresh evidence.

Learning:
- learning/README.md: how to use the shared anchor with this project's own
  Preskill bridge and 30-milestone map.
- learning/PRESKILL_BRIDGE.md: John Preskill, Quantum Information, Chapter 7,
  Quantum Error Correction, author-hosted draft updated March 2026. This is
  the single educational anchor shared with Error-Transparent Locality.
  This project's bridge selects chapter sections, translates notation and
  develops the additional syndrome-measurement and recovery arguments.
- learning/MILESTONES.md: exactly M01-M30, with 12 background/preliminaries
  milestones and 18 narrative/innovation milestones. Each includes a central
  question, target, earlier dependencies, conceptual connection and sources.
- [Sister project's Preskill bridge](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Error-Transparent-Locality/blob/main/learning/PRESKILL_BRIDGE.md):
  the same chapter supports a distinct protected-gate bridge and milestone map.
  Keep its unknown-time fault model separate from prescribed syndrome readout.

Preserve these distinctions:
- S is the entire stabilizer group, not a generator list. Phase-free membership
  and physical signed operators have different roles.
- Equal support means exactly equal nonidentity sites. A circuit has no proper
  nonempty zero-syndrome subword of its fixed Pauli labels. An arbitrary even
  logical word need not be a circuit.
- r(S) and r_S denote the same invariant. Finite r is even and >=d; even d
  implies r=d. Infinity means exact recoverability for every product U.
- Half-diamond error and entanglement infidelity need not coincide for general U.
  They coincide for the explicit repetition witnesses. Both worst-case optimized
  errors have exponent r for a fixed code; constants may depend on that code.
- The family comparison has n=2*5^m, k=2, d=3^m. A physical CNOT conjugates
  the code and changes r from infinity to 3^m+1. The protected logical entangler
  instead keeps the product code and its original syndrome measurement fixed.
- The gate model demands exact full-sector intertwining for every Pauli error
  of the stated weight, up to consistent scalar shifts. Native coupling cost
  is the sum of absolute nonidentity bare Hermitian Pauli coefficients, not
  operator norm. omega is half the logical spectral width.
- On Q_m, d=3^m and one/two/three-error minimum orders are d+2t, with
  family-specific coupling optima at those orders. t=1 requires m>=1; t=2,3
  require m>=2. Readout remains r_S=infinity.
- For product Q_m blocks with m>=2, target h_L=Omega P+cI, Omega!=0 and
  nonidentity logical Pauli string P of weight p>=1, the three-error string
  cost is |Omega| J_3(p*d). Target coset minimum p*d
  differs from ordinary code distance d. The pure-string optimum does not give
  an optimal arbitrary mixed-Hamiltonian budget at one common locality cap.
- Compact dense specification, sparse existence, explicit sparse synthesis,
  term count and coefficient bit size are separate resources.
- Readout and protected-gate noise assumptions are separate; universal encoded
  control here does not assert a joint threshold or efficient hardware synthesis.
- General outcome-conditioned recovery and the even-repetition mechanism are
  inherited ingredients. Consult RELATED_WORK before assigning novelty.
- Finite checks do not replace general proofs, peer review or source attribution.
- The common Preskill educational anchor supplies foundations. Each project
  retains its own bridge and 30-milestone map. Research citations are
  necessary attribution, not additional assigned educational anchors.
